title: VTC Events — Registrations — List — payload
description: List an event's registrations as the caller may see them: every registration, answers included, for the event's hosts; on a `visible` roster, for a registrant who is going or maybe, the others who are going or maybe — who, their status and their guests, nothing else; a member registered under a persona is shown by the persona identifier and never as the member (VTI-EVT-230). On a `hidden` roster nobody but the hosts reads any. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

statuses.description: Hosts only: only registrations in one of these statuses. Absent means every status for a host. Refused for the roster view, which is always `going` and `maybe`.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`, bound to the caller, the event and the filters; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 100; the responder chooses a default (50) and MAY return fewer.

occurrence.description: Only registrations for this occurrence, or for the whole series.

View.title: View
View.description: Which view the caller was given. `host`: the event's hosts — every registration, all of it (VTI-EVT-073). `roster`: a registrant on a `visible` roster — who else is going or maybe (VTI-EVT-053).

EventRosterEntry.title: EventRosterEntry
EventRosterEntry.description: Another registrant as the roster view shows them: who, whether going or maybe, and how many guests. Exactly one of `entryId` (a member registered by the identifier they are a member by) and `registrantDid` (a member registered under a persona, VTI-EVT-230) names them. Never their answers, their acknowledgement or when they registered (VTI-EVT-053); never a persona's member.

entryId.description: A member registered by the identifier they are a member by: their directory entry.

registrantDid.description: A member registered under a persona (VTI-EVT-230): the persona identifier they registered with, and nothing that leads to the member. Never a partner's member or a guest, who are counted in `othersGoing` and not named (VTI-EVT-134, VTI-EVT-153).

status.description: Whether the registrant is going or maybe; the roster view shows no other status.

guests.description: Plus-ones the registrant brings; 0 where none.

Response.title: VTC Events — Registrations — List — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/registrations/list/0.4 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/registrations/list/0.4#response. `registrations` is present exactly when `view` is `host`, `roster` exactly when it is `roster`.

registrations.description: Host view: registrations in order of `createdAt`, then `registrationId`; waitlisted ones carry `waitlistPosition`.

roster.description: Roster view: registrants going or maybe, the caller included — those named by `entryId` first, in order of `entryId`, then those named by `registrantDid`, in order of `registrantDid`.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page; pass it back as `cursor`. Absent on the last page — never `null`.

othersGoing.description: Roster view only: registrants going or maybe who are not members of the community — partners' members and guests — counted, never named (VTI-EVT-134, VTI-EVT-153). A persona registration is a member's and is named, by its persona identifier, in `roster`.
